d:
[Branded Content] Can a strong hybrid take you from sea level to more than 14,000 ft without stopping for fuel?
We put Toyota's hybrid technology to the test with the Urban Cruiser Hyryder and Innova Hycross, setting off from Mandarmani Beach on the Bay of Bengal and heading towards Nathula Pass in the Himalayas.
The mission was to attempt two records:
Highest elevation reached on a single tank of fuel.
Highest elevation reached within 24 hours.
The Urban Cruiser Hyryder took on the single-tank elevation record, while the Innova Hycross attempted the 24-hour elevation record.
